owner_decisions: This case promotes the historical Runic Gauntlets four-of-five partial-state control into a tracked current-economy corpus without modifying its archived evidence.
The case uses the pinned Allflame snapshot plus an explicit one-chaos base input; the base value is a fixture input rather than a universal default.

Exact closure is preferred. A bounded result qualifies only when it publishes the cheapest available executable policy, compiles it, independently exact-evaluates it, completes 10,000 Simulator runs, and reports honest bounds and unresolved obligations within ten minutes.
